descriptions.w3d_vec4_tables_destroy_8035a244: Deleting destructor of a record with four int vectors: frees each vector's storage in reverse order, then the record when flag bit 0 is set.
descriptions.w3d_row_table_destroy_8034be70: Deleting destructor of a row table: frees the extra vector, destroys every row (freeing its cells), frees the row storage, then the table when flag bit 0 is set.
descriptions.w3d_list_holder_clear_8034aef4: Deletes the holder's int list and pair list (destroying their elements and storage) and clears both pointers.
